mil3.3.7:1.2: Bhante Nāgasena, yattha cakkhuviññāṇaṃ uppajjati tattha manoviññāṇam-pi uppajjatīti. -
mil3.3.7:1.3: Āma mahārāja, yattha cakkhuviññāṇaṃ uppajjati tattha manoviññāṇam-pi uppajjatīti. -
mil3.3.7:2.1: Kin-nu kho bhante Nāgasena paṭhamaṃ cakkhuviññāṇaṃ uppajjati pacchā manoviññāṇaṃ, udāhu manoviññāṇaṃ paṭhamaṃ uppajjati pacchā cakkhuviññāṇan-ti. -
mil3.3.7:2.2: Paṭhamaṃ mahārāja cakkhuviññāṇaṃ uppajjati pacchā manoviññāṇan-ti. -
mil3.3.7:3.1: Kin-nu kho bhante Nāgasena cakkhuviññāṇaṃ manoviññāṇaṃ āṇāpeti: yatthāhaṃ uppajjāmi tvam-pi tattha uppajjāhiti, udāhu manoviññāṇaṃ cakkhuviññāṇaṃ āṇāpeti: yattha tvaṃ uppajjissasi aham-pi tattha uppajjissāmīti. -
mil3.3.7:3.2: Na hi mahārāja, anallāpo tesaṃ aññamaññehīti. -
mil3.3.7:4.1: Katham-bhante Nāgasena yattha cakkhuviññāṇaṃ uppajjati tattha manoviññāṇam-pi uppajjatīti. -
mil3.3.7:4.2: Ninnattā ca mahārāja dvārattā ca ciṇṇattā ca samudācaritattā cāti. -
mil3.3.7:5.1: Kathambhante Nāgasena ninnattā yattha cakkhuviññāṇaṃ uppajjati tattha manoviññāṇam-pi uppajjati,
mil3.3.7:5.3: Taṃ kim-maññasi mahārāja: deve vassante katamena udakaṃ gaccheyyāti. -
mil3.3.7:5.5: Athāparena samayena devo vasseyya, katamena taṃ udakaṃ gaccheyyāti. -
mil3.3.7:5.6: Yena bhante purimaṃ udakaṃ gataṃ tam-pi tena gaccheyyāti. -
mil3.3.7:6.1: Kin-nu- kho mahārāja purimaṃ udakaṃ pacchimaṃ udakaṃ āṇāpeti: yenāhaṃ gacchāmi tvam-pi tena gacchāhīti, pacchimaṃ vā udakaṃ purimaṃ udakaṃ āṇāpeti: yena tvaṃ gacchissasi aham-pi tena gacchissāmīti. -
mil3.3.7:6.2: Na hi bhante, anālāpo tesaṃ aññamaññehi, ninnattā gacchantīti. -
mil3.3.7:6.3: Evameva kho mahārāja ninnattā yattha cakkhuviññāṇaṃ uppajjati tattha manoviññāṇam-pi uppajjati, na cakkhuviññāṇaṃ manoviññāṇaṃ āṇāpeti: yatthāhaṃ uppajjāmi tvam-pi tattha uppajjāhīti, na pi manoviññāṇaṃ cakkhuviññāṇaṃ āṇāpeti: yattha tvaṃ uppajjissasi aham-pi tattha uppajjissāmīti, anālāpo tesaṃ aññamaññehi, ninnattā uppajjantīti. -
mil3.3.7:7.1: Katham-bhante Nāgasena dvārattā yattha cakkhuviññāṇaṃ uppajjati tattha manoviññāṇam-pi uppajjati,
mil3.3.7:7.3: Taṃ kim-maññasi mahārāja: rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ daḷhapākāratoraṇaṃ ekadvāraṃ, tato puriso nikkhamitukāmo bhaveyya, katamena nikkhameyyāti. -
mil3.3.7:7.5: Athāparo puriso nikkhamitukāmo bhaveyya, katamena so nikkhameyyāti. -
mil3.3.7:7.6: Yena bhante purimo puriso nikkhanto so pi tena nikkhameyyāti. -
mil3.3.7:8.1: Kin-nu kho mahārāja purimo puriso pacchimaṃ purisaṃ āṇāpeti: yenāhaṃ gacchāmi tvam-pi tena gacchāhīti, pacchimo vā puriso purimaṃ purisaṃ āṇāpeti: yena tvaṃ gacchissasi aham-pi tena gacchissāmīti. -
mil3.3.7:8.2: Na hi bhante, anālāpo tesaṃ aññamaññehi, dvārattā gacchantīti.-Evam-
mil3.3.7:8.3: eva kho mahārāja dvārattā yattha cakkhuviññāṇaṃ uppajjati tattha manoviññāṇam-pi uppajjati, na ca cakkhuviññāṇaṃ manoviññāṇaṃ āṇāpeti: yatthāhaṃ uppajjāmi tvam-pi tattha uppajjāhīti, nāpi manoviññāṇaṃ cakkhuviññāṇaṃ āṇāpeti: yattha tvaṃ uppajjissasi aham-pi tattha uppajjissāmīti, anālāpo tesaṃ aññamaññehi, dvārattā uppajjantīti. -
mil3.3.7:9.1: Katham-bhante Nāgasena ciṇṇattā yattha cakkhuviññāṇaṃ uppajjati tattha manoviññāṇam-pi uppajjati,
mil3.3.7:9.3: Taṃ kim-maññasi mahārāja: paṭhamaṃ ekaṃ sakaṭaṃ gaccheyya, atha dutiyaṃ sakaṭaṃ katamena gaccheyyāti. -
mil3.3.7:9.4: Yena bhante purimaṃ sakaṭaṃ gataṃ tam-pi tena gaccheyyāti. -
mil3.3.7:10.1: Kin-nu kho mahārāja purimaṃ sakaṭaṃ pacchimaṃ sakaṭaṃ āṇāpeti: yenāhaṃ gacchāmi tvam-pi tena gacchāhīti, pacchimaṃ vā sakaṭaṃ purimaṃ sakaṭaṃ āṇāpeti: yena tvaṃ gacchissasi aham-pi tena gacchissāmīti. -
mil3.3.7:10.2: Na hi bhante, anālāpo tesaṃ aññamaññehi, ciṇṇattā gacchantīti.
mil3.3.7:10.3: Evam-eva kho mahārāja ciṇṇattā yattha cakkhuviññāṇaṃ uppajjati tattha manoviññāṇam-pi uppajjati, na ca cakkhuviññāṇaṃ manoviññāṇaṃ āṇāpeti: yatthāhaṃ uppajjāmi tvam-pi tattha uppajjāhīti, nāpi manoviññāṇaṃ cakkhuviññāṇaṃ āṇāpeti: yattha tvaṃ uppajjissasi aham-pi tattha uppajjissāmīti, anālāpo tesaṃ aññamaññehi, ciṇṇattā uppajjantīti. -
mil3.3.7:11.1: Katham-bhante Nāgasena samudācaritattā yattha cakkhuviññāṇaṃ uppajjati tattha manoviññāṇam-pi uppajjati,
mil3.3.7:11.3: Yathā mahārāja muddā-gaṇanā-sankhā-lekhā-sippaṭṭhānesu ādikammikassa dandhāyanā bhavati, athāparena samayena nisammakiriyāya samudācaritattā adandhāyanā bhavati,
mil3.3.7:11.4: evam-eva kho mahārāja samudācaritattā yattha cakkhuviññāṇaṃ uppajjati tattha manoviññāṇaṃ-pi uppajjati, na ca cakkhuviññāṇaṃ manoviññāṇaṃ āṇāpeti: yatthāhaṃ uppajjāmi tvam-pi tattha uppajjāhīti, nāpi manoviññāṇaṃ cakkhuviññāṇaṃ āṇāpeti: yattha tvaṃ uppajjissasi aham-pi tattha uppajjissāmīti, anālāpo tesaṃ aññamaññehi, samudācaritattā uppajjantīti. -
mil3.3.7:12.1: Bhante Nāgasena, yattha sotaviññāṇaṃ uppajjati tattha manoviññāṇam-pi uppajjati -pe-
mil3.3.7:12.2: yattha ghānaviññāṇaṃ uppajjati, yattha jivhāviññāṇaṃ uppajjati, yattha kāyaviññāṇaṃ uppajjattattha manoviññāṇam-pi uppajjatīti. -
mil3.3.7:12.3: Āma mahārāja, yattha kāyaviññāṇaṃ uppajjati tattha manoviññāṇam-pi uppajjatīti. -
mil3.3.7:13.1: Kin-nu kho bhante Nāgasena paṭhamaṃ kāyaviññāṇaṃ uppajjati pacchā manoviññāṇaṃ, udāhu manoviññāṇaṃ paṭhamaṃ uppajjati pacchā kāyaviññāṇan-ti.
mil3.3.7:13.2: Kāyaviññāṇaṃ mahārāja paṭhamaṃ uppajjati pacchā manoviññāṇan-ti. -
